note: Evaluator file. Module texts and task attributes are shown to the subject; true prices are computed by learning_attribution.py and never shown. 'note' fields are design intent for the analyst and are never shown.

BASE.title: Base price table
BASE.text: Base price by parcel weight: up to 2 kg: 7 credits; over 2 kg up to 5 kg: 11 credits; over 5 kg up to 10 kg: 18 credits.

HEAVY.title: Heavy parcel rule
HEAVY.text: Parcels over 10 kg: the base price is 18 credits plus 3 credits for every started kilogram above 10 kg.

ZONE.title: Destination zone multipliers
ZONE.text: Multiply the base price by the destination zone factor: zone A x1, zone B x2, zone C x3, zone D x4.

ZONE_OLD.title: Zone surcharge schedule (regional office)
ZONE_OLD.text: Zone surcharge schedule: zone A x1, zone B x1.5, zone C x2.5, zone D x3. Apply the factor to the base price.

FRAG.title: Fragile handling rule
FRAG.text: Fragile parcels: add a 9-credit handling fee after all multipliers.

EXPR.title: Express service rule
EXPR.text: Express service doubles the price after the zone factor has been applied and before any handling fee is added.

ROUND.title: Rounding rule
ROUND.text: Final prices are always rounded up to the next multiple of 5 credits.

CUSTOMS.title: Customs declarations
CUSTOMS.text: Parcels to zones C and D whose contents are worth more than 200 credits need customs form CX-2, listing the contents category and the sender's registry number.

MEMO.title: Orbital Post service memo
MEMO.text: Orbital Post prices are quoted in credits. All parcels are weighed on certified scales, and the destination zone is printed on every label.

EXAMPLES.title: Worked pricing examples
EXAMPLES.text: Worked examples: (1) 3.0 kg to zone B: 11 x 2 = 22, price 25. (2) 7.0 kg to zone A: 18 x 1 = 18, price 20. (3) 1.0 kg to zone C: 7 x 3 = 21, price 25.

ERRATA.title: Notice on zone schedules
ERRATA.text: Notice: the regional office zone surcharge schedule has been withdrawn and must not be used. Only the destination zone multipliers are valid.

MEMO_R.title: Orbital Post service memo
MEMO_R.text: Orbital Post prices are quoted in credits, and every price is charged at the next multiple of 5 credits. All parcels are weighed on certified scales, and the destination zone is printed on every label.
